bulletin.title: Daily Bulletin
bulletin.noMatches: No analyzed matches for this date.
bulletin.pipelineNote: Matches will appear here after the daily pipeline runs.

results.title: Results
results.noFilter: No matches found for this filter.
results.noMatchesToday: No confirmed match results for today yet.
results.noMatchesDate: No confirmed match results found for this date.
results.scheduledNote: Upcoming and ongoing matches are shown on the Bulletin page.

evaluation.title: Evaluation
evaluation.brierTooltip: Brier Score — lower = better calibrated (0 = perfect, 0.667 = random)
evaluation.noEvalMatches: No finished matches available for evaluation on this date.
evaluation.patternNote: This tab shows what today's algorithm would say for past matches (backtest-like); these are not the predictions shown on the day.

perf.liftHint: Versus the baseline pick on the same matches (HT baseline for live)
perf.calibrationHint: Average shown probability versus actual hit rate
perf.stage_cok_erken: Too early — small sample, not reliable yet
perf.stage_on_bulgu: Preliminary — will firm up as the sample grows
perf.emptyLive: Live predictions are recorded automatically at half-time; they will appear here as matches are played.
perf.emptyDay: No recorded predictions for this day.
perf.backtestNote: Backtest: what today's rules would have said on past matches — each match only sees data known at that moment (no leakage). Never mixed with recorded predictions; real performance is on the Live HT and Pre-match tabs.
perf.noRuns: No backtest runs yet (created with the backtest-ledger command).
perf.informationalHint: Not in Top Picks — measured only, as it does not beat the league average.
perf.marketSummaryHint: Each archive's top selection per market (no threshold) — measured only, not a recommendation.
perf.chartAria: Calibration chart: shown probability vs observed hit rate; the diagonal is perfect calibration.

live.title: Live
live.htDescription: Full-time prediction for matches at half-time or in the second half: past matches with the same league and half-time score, adjusted by the pre-match A1+A2+A3 view.
live.noLiveMatches: No top-league match is at half-time or in the second half right now.
live.noLiveNote: When matches reach half-time, the full-time prediction appears here and is recorded at that moment.

prediction.title: Full-time prediction
prediction.frozenTooltip: This prediction was recorded immutably at half-time; its result is tracked on the Evaluation page.
prediction.archivesNote: Secondary information — less reliable than the main prediction because samples are small.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or may have been moved.

cart.title: Bet Cart
cart.disclaimer: Percentages are frequencies from past archive matches. They cannot be used as joint probabilities or betting odds.

topPicks.title: Pre-match pick
topPicks.emptyMessage: No pick meets the publishing rule for this match (pool ≥30 matches and a probability at least 5 points above the league average). Detailed archive statistics are shown below for information.
topPicks.disclaimer: The pick is frozen before kickoff and its result is tracked on the Evaluation page. The percentage is the A1+A2+A3 pooled probability shrunk to the last-3-season league average; in backtests the shown probability matches the actual hit rate.
topPicks.settingsChanged: This pick was frozen before kickoff with different archive settings; the archive percentages below use the current settings, so they may not match exactly.

analyze.noMatchedData: No matched archive match data found.
analyze.analyzingNote: First analysis may take longer depending on the data source.
analyze.noForecast: No prediction could be generated for this match
analyze.noScores: No scores with 3.5+ ratio found for this period
analyze.listNotStored: Matches exist but the list is not stored for this record yet (it will appear after recompute).

skipReasons.not_league_match: This is not a league match (cup or friendly). No prediction can be generated.
skipReasons.home_team_insufficient: The home team has not played enough league matches this season (minimum 5 required).
skipReasons.away_team_insufficient: The away team has not played enough league matches this season (minimum 5 required).
skipReasons.h2h_insufficient: Not enough head-to-head history found between these two teams (minimum 5 league matches required).
skipReasons.data_fetch_failed: An error occurred while fetching match data. Please try again later.

marketSummary.title: Market Summary
marketSummary.subtitle: most frequent selection in archive
marketSummary.agreementTooltip: {n} archives agree on the same pick
marketSummary.footer: number of archives agreeing on the same pick (✦2 / ✦3). Percentages are archive frequencies, not probabilities.

iddaa.noData: Insufficient archive data found for this period.
iddaa.noDataNote: Archive 1 requires at least 5, Archive 2/3 requires at least 1 match
